reviewerB.rationale: Tests the locations of Sun-Earth Lagrange points, which arise from the gravitational and orbital dynamics of the two-body system.

reviewerB.rationale: Directly asks which lithification, metamorphism and solidification processes belong to the rock cycle.

reviewerB.rationale: Tests the short-wave entry and long-wave heat-retention mechanism underlying the greenhouse effect.

reviewerB.rationale: Tests axial inclination as the cause of seasonal variation in solar energy received at a place on Earth.

reviewerB.rationale: Classifies creep, mudflow, solifluction and slump by the speed of mass movement.
